title: [Epic] Phase 0 - Foundation & spec baseline
body:
## Goal
Lock the v4 workbook as the requirements baseline and de-risk before UI/mobile work.

## Deliverables
- [ ] Signed-off spec version (Master Template v4 + Raw vs Derived Register + Change Log)
- [ ] Open questions doc resolved (corroboration, False Start, VCI3M classes, confirm/approve separation, West Africa NMHS products)
- [ ] Pilot priority decision (SCLoWFER Ghana vs Green Schools Kenya)
- [ ] `protocol_version` constant and TILKIT module layout in `tk/`
- [ ] Golden fixtures extracted from demo workbook (11-row + frog trace metadata)

## References
- `tilkit_docs/_extracted.txt` (Developer Brief §10–11)
- `tilkit_docs/TILKIT_Weather_Indicator_Log_v4_DEMO_hypothetical_data.xlsx`

title: [Epic] Phase 2 - Forecast rules engine (Excel parity)
body:
## Goal
Single server-side rules engine; **must match workbook** for all fixtures.

## Deliverables
- [ ] Eligibility gate + exclusion reasons + reconciliation assertion
- [ ] Weighting: rating-based → hit-rate-based; corroboration cap; decision relevance; optional prior
- [ ] Tallies: simple, weighted, priority-adjusted + windows
- [ ] Post-season scoring: Hit / Miss / False Start
- [ ] CLI `tilkit:tally {site} {season}`
- [ ] All golden tests green (frog trace, 11-row demo, 6-sign example)

## References
- Developer Brief §5 Forecast engine, §10.2–10.3 acceptance
- `tilkit_docs/calculations/`
